data.one_liner: An intuitive and user-friendly Web User Interface framework for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Bones_UI provides a framework for building web user interfaces in Dart. It includes a CLI to create and serve projects, component rendering abstractions, routing capabilities, and built-in support for unit testing components in a browser environment.
use_when: You want to build web user interfaces using pure Dart.
You need an integrated CLI for project generation, serving, and testing.
You want support for defining component hierarchies and handling routing on the web.
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter application targeting mobile or desktop.
You prefer standard Flutter widgets over a dedicated web-first framework.
strengths: Includes a dedicated CLI for scaffolding and managing projects.
Comes with testing utilities specifically designed for UI roots and routing.
Supports component-based structure for web apps in Dart.
weaknesses: Limited primarily to web platform usage.
Smaller ecosystem and community compared to mainstream UI frameworks.
data.setup_notes: Activate the CLI globally using 'dart pub global activate bones_ui' to create and manage projects.
